examples.title: GDPR Consent Manager
examples.description: Consent management component for GDPR compliance
examples.code:
<ConsentManager
  consents={consents}
  onConsentChange={(key, value) => setConsents({ ...consents, [key]: value })}
  isLoading={isLoading}
  isSaving={isSaving}
  isError={isError}
  isSuccess={isSuccess}
  hasChanges={hasChanges}
  onSave={handleSave}
  lastUpdated={lastUpdated}
  consentSettings={consentSettings}
  labels={labels}
/>

examples.title: Data Export Request Card
examples.description: Component for users to request their data export (GDPR Article 15)
examples.code:
<DataExportCard
  onRequestExport={handleRequestExport}
  isRequesting={isRequesting}
  lastExportDate={lastExportDate}
  labels={{
    title: 'Export Your Data',
    description: 'Download a copy of all your personal data',
    button: 'Request Export',
    requesting: 'Preparing export...'
  }}
/>

examples.title: Delete Account Card
examples.description: Component for account deletion (GDPR Article 17 - Right to erasure)
examples.code:
<DeleteAccountCard
  onRequestDeletion={handleRequestDeletion}
  isRequesting={isRequesting}
  labels={{
    title: 'Delete Account',
    description: 'Permanently delete your account and all associated data',
    warning: 'This action cannot be undone',
    button: 'Delete Account',
    requesting: 'Processing deletion...'
  }}
/>

examples.title: Privacy Settings
examples.description: Privacy settings component for managing data preferences
examples.code:
<ConsentSettings
  settings={privacySettings}
  onSettingChange={(key, value) => updateSetting(key, value)}
  isLoading={isLoading}
  labels={{
    title: 'Privacy Settings',
    description: 'Manage your privacy preferences',
    save: 'Save Preferences'
  }}
/>

examples.title: Data Subject Request Form
examples.description: Form for submitting GDPR data subject requests (Article 15-22)
examples.code:
<DataSubjectRequestForm
  requestType={requestType}
  onSubmit={handleSubmit}
  isLoading={isLoading}
  labels={{
    title: 'Data Subject Request',
    description: 'Request access, rectification, or erasure of your data',
    submit: 'Submit Request'
  }}
/>

examples.title: GDPR Consent Popup
examples.description: Initial consent popup for first-time visitors
examples.code:
<ConsentPopup
  isOpen={showConsent}
  onAccept={handleAcceptAll}
  onReject={handleRejectAll}
  onCustomize={handleCustomize}
  consentSettings={consentSettings}
  labels={{
    title: 'We value your privacy',
    description: 'We use cookies to improve your experience',
    acceptAll: 'Accept All',
    rejectAll: 'Reject All',
    customize: 'Customize'
  }}
/>
